property_summary: For any admissible deposit amount, after SetLogFile has been called with a valid LogFile address, a payable Deposit must succeed (the stored Log is functional); the mutant stores address(0), so every Deposit reverts when it calls Log.AddMessage.
change_summary: Replace the assignment Log = LogFile(_log) with Log = LogFile(address(0)), so SetLogFile always leaves the Log variable as zero regardless of the argument.
